name: cortexai-server
description: Root configuration for unified production deployment

scripts.install-all: npm install && npm install --prefix gateway && npm install --prefix services/agent && npm install --prefix services/auth && npm install --prefix services/billing && npm install --prefix services/chat
scripts.start: concurrently "node services/agent/index.js" "node services/auth/index.js" "node services/billing/index.js" "node services/chat/index.js" "wait-on tcp:8001 tcp:8002 tcp:8003 tcp:8004 && node gateway/index.js"
scripts.dev: concurrently "node services/agent/index.js" "node services/auth/index.js" "node services/billing/index.js" "node services/chat/index.js" "wait-on tcp:8001 tcp:8002 tcp:8003 tcp:8004 && node gateway/index.js"
